tcad_track.mesh: DEVSIM structured mesh; Gmsh optional for later irregular geometry
tcad_track.baseline_scope: complete T01 single-gate drift-diffusion numerical gate plus complete T02 dual-gate numerical gate and all five numerical T03 groups: P4-L, P1 bias-and-coupling, P2 bottom-interface and bulk traps with preserved V1/V2 failures and passed V3, P3 contact with preserved V1 failure and passed V2, and P5 V_t-only temperature sensitivity with passed formal runner and independent persisted-evidence check
tcad_track.next_scope: establish a formal M00 teaching compact-model input and validation contract from qualified T01/T02/T03 numerical curves; freeze dataset eligibility, train/holdout split, model routes, extraction and optimization methods, linear/log error metrics, outputs, failure retention, and evidence boundary before any compact-model fitting or SPICE run, while M01, circuit cells, layout, PEX, and HZO remain closed
tcad_track.evidence_boundary: T02-C closes only the frozen teaching-model numerical gate. T03-P4-L adds one complete E3 three-point channel-length group while retaining the failed ideal 1/L diagnostic. Numerical P1 is complete through E3 P1-BIAS and P1-CAP-RATIO substages; the latter varies a fixed-total-coupling allocation proxy and is not measured capacitance, measured Al2O3 permittivity, or a fabricated asymmetric stack. The T03-P2 bottom-interface DIT substage has E3 contract, equation-smoke, formal three-point transfer-sensitivity, persisted-state, and independent-check evidence. The bulk-trap input contract is E3 static evidence, and its zero-control, NTA-reference, and NGA-reference equation smoke completed 3 devices and 21 coupled DC solves with E2 runner evidence and E3 independent persisted-evidence verification. Formal V1 completed 8 devices, 328 converged DC records and 248 transfer points but correctly remained E0/FAIL because NTA=5e19 did not bracket the unchanged 1e-5 A/cm VTH criterion by VTG=1.0 V and the inherited near-zero internal-potential gate was inapplicable to nonzero occupied trap charge. Formal V2 completed 8 devices, 440 converged DC records, 360 transfer points, 8 states and 48 VTK files but correctly remained E0/FAIL because the diagnostic VTH+0.2 V gm evaluation lacked the upper neighbor required by the frozen central-difference method. Both failures, their exact inputs, runners, logs, curves, states and reports are preserved; no V2 independent check was run. The V3 E3 static contract changed only the common gate-grid stop from 1.7 V to the user-approved 1.8 V and retained every density point, equation, extraction method, acceptance threshold and evidence boundary. The subsequent V3 runner completed 8 isolated devices, 456 converged DC solves, 376 transfer points, 8 states and 48 VTK files with E2 evidence; the independent persisted-evidence checker passed 16/16 at E3 and closes P2 within the frozen quasi-static teaching-model boundary. NTA shows increasing VTH and SS proxies with decreasing gm, while NGA shows increasing VTH and decreasing gm but a mildly decreasing SS proxy; these directions are diagnostics, not physical mechanism or completion gates. P3 contact V1 completed all 12 devices, 243 converged DC solves, 156 reported points, 3 states and 18 VTK files, and passed 24 of 25 runner gates, but remains E0/FAIL because its relative terminal-current imbalance gate was incorrectly applied to nine external-VDS=0 numerical-noise points. Its maximum nonzero-VDS relative imbalance was 3.35344e-11 and its zero-VDS maximum absolute current was 1.08454e-19 A/cm, both within the unchanged thresholds; no V1 independent check was run. The V1 config, runner, report, log, tables, figures, states, original failure manifest and filename-collision supplement are preserved. The P3 V2 E3 static recovery contract changed only gate applicability and unique output/archive paths: the unchanged 1e-5 relative threshold applies at external VDS>0, while the unchanged 1e-16 A/cm absolute threshold applies at external VDS=0. R_pair*W=0/0.5/4.5 kOhm*um, physical/model inputs, bias grid, extraction and the 12-device/243-DC/156-point budget remained unchanged. The subsequent single V2 run completed 12 devices, 243 converged DC solves, 156 points, 3 states and 18 VTK files; all 25 runner gates passed at E2 and the independent checker passed 20/20 at E3. The maximum nonzero-VDS relative terminal-current imbalance was 3.35344e-11, the maximum zero-VDS absolute current was 1.08454e-19 A/cm, circuit KCL and Ohm-law residuals were 2.42178e-12 and 1.20922e-12, and voltage-partition residual was zero. The high resistance proxy reduced the sampled high-gate current by 0.161396% and the extracted external total-resistance-width proxy increased from 2780.13345 to 2784.63204 kOhm*um; these are controlled numerical responses, not physical contact parameters. V2 completion does not reinterpret V1 as PASS. The two nonzero magnitudes remain E1 literature anchors mapped by an explicit project total-pair teaching convention; they are not project measurements, TLM extraction, Ti/Ni project parameters or barrier/injection evidence. P3 is complete only within the frozen uncalibrated 2D teaching-model boundary. The P5 E3 static contract froze 250/300/350 K and only V_t=8.617333262e-5*T in the existing Scharfetter-Gummel current. The single formal run then completed 3 fresh devices, 123 converged DC solves, 93 transfer points, 3 states and 18 VTK files; all 14 runner gates passed at E2 and the independent checker passed 15/15 at E3. The maximum terminal-current imbalance was 4.37301e-10 and the 300 K curve, state, VTH and gm reproduced T02-C exactly. Across 250/300/350 K, the VTH proxy was 0.245409/0.263857/0.281977 V, SS proxy was 117.138/137.594/157.796 mV/dec, gm proxy was 3.98472e-5/3.93760e-5/3.88128e-5 S/cm, low-gate current proxy was 4.03293e-11/2.10090e-10/6.94544e-10 A/cm, and high-gate current proxy was 3.64698e-5/3.59372e-5/3.52925e-5 A/cm. Mobility remained fixed at 35.5 cm2/(V*s), while DOS, band parameters, permittivities, contacts, traps, geometry and biases remained fixed. Thus all five numerical T03 groups are complete only within the frozen uncalibrated teaching-model boundary. These results do not establish experimental or physical IGZO temperature dependence, activation energy, mobility/DOS/contact/trap temperature laws, physical SS/VTH/Ioff/Ion, operating range, self-heating, reliability, uncertainty, compact models, circuit cells, layout, PEX, or HZO evidence.

teaching_baseline.allowed_use: T01 teaching-parameter initialization and sanity checks
teaching_baseline.prohibited_use: experimental fitting or calibrated dual-gate prediction

baseline_process.top_gate_status: research extension; not present in the stated fabricated baseline

logic_style.principle: Use a second gate to tune the load-device effective threshold while the driver network implements n-type ratioed logic.
limitations: ratioed logic has static current in the low-output state
noise margin and output swing require load/driver sizing
active-load claims require a calibrated dual-gate threshold shift

evidence_boundary: Teaching and research PDK only; not foundry sign-off. The ngspice model is a behavioral equivalent, not native HSPICE Level61. Active-load logic remains planned until dual-gate threshold control is calibrated.
